versions.content: The SOME/IP transformer on the trigger source side of transformed external trigger events shall construct header in the following way: • Set the Request ID – to 0x00 if sessionHandlingSR of SOMEIPTransformationISignal- Props is not set to sessionHandlingActive – the current value of the Session Handling ID counter otherwise • Set the Protocol Version according [SWS_SomeIpXf_00029] • Set the Interface Version. If interfaceVersion of SOMEIPTransforma- tionISignalProps is set, this shall be used. Otherwise interfaceVersion of SOMEIPTransformationDescription shall be used. • Set the Message Type to REQUEST_NO_RETURN (i.e. 0x01 ) • Set the Return Code to 0x00
